text.heartfall.config.title: Heartfall Options
text.heartfall.config.option.minHeal.des: The minimum amount of health a single health shard can restore.
text.heartfall.config.option.maxHeal.des: The maximum amount of health a single health shard can restore.
text.heartfall.config.option.pickupRange: The block radius around a player within which health shards are pulled toward them.
text.heartfall.config.option.deathAnimat: Duration of the scaling/fade animation out when a shard is consumed (in game ticks).
text.heartfall.config.option.lifespanTic: Total time a health shard remains on the ground before despawning (in game ticks).
text.heartfall.config.option.baseDropCha: The default drop probability when a valid living entity dies.
text.heartfall.config.option.maxDropChan: The highest possible drop probability, scaled based on how low the player's current health status is.
